copy.storyHeading: Twenty years of contracts we could defend
story: Amanah Reka was founded in 2006 doing shoplot fit-outs in Seksyen 7. We learned early that the contractors who survive are the ones whose paperwork holds up — the contract, the insurance, the submitted plans, the certified progress claims.

Twenty years later we run residential and commercial work side by side with 45 staff and crew. Clients come to us when the job needs approvals, an engineer's endorsement, or simply an invoice their accountant will accept.

process.title: Assessment & Tender
process.text: A site assessment, then a full bill of quantities. You receive a tender-standard document where every item is measured and priced, suitable for comparing against other contractors line by line.

process.title: Contract & Approvals
process.text: A written contract with payment stages tied to completed work, not calendar dates. Where local council, Bomba or engineer's endorsement is required, we prepare and lodge the submissions.

process.title: Execution & Liability
process.text: Supervised daily by our own site agent, with progress claims certified before payment. Handover includes as-built drawings and a twelve-month defect liability period we actually honour.
